mentions.name: OnlyEV
mentions.description: This is an EV marketplace/advertising site for electric vehicles, competing with car listing platforms like AutoTrader, Cars.com, and TrueCar. It includes a cash offer lead routing system as part of its offering, with the goal of taking a slice of the EV ads market.
mentions.problem: Taking a slice of the EV ads market away from large incumbent car listing platforms.
